message: Versions before 1.26.0 must update manually via SSH - the in-app Update button can't cross this boundary. Run: curl -fsSL -H "Cache-Control: no-cache" https://raw.githubusercontent.com/N6LKA/AllStar-Herald/main/install.sh | sudo bash - see https://github.com/N6LKA/AllStar-Herald/discussions/52 for details.
